steps.js: const tb=document.querySelector('table'); const t=(tb||document.body).innerText; return {rows:tb?tb.querySelectorAll('tbody tr').length:0, rawPaths:(t.match(/\/api\/[\w\/{}-]+/g)||[]).slice(0,5), rawMethods:(t.match(/\b(POST|PUT|DELETE)\b/g)||[]).length, other:(t.match(/其他操作/g)||[]).length, sample:[...(tb?.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')||[])].slice(0,4).map(r=>r.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,80)), titleHasPath:[...(tb?.querySelectorAll('[title]')||[])].some(e=>/\/api\//.test(e.title)), techDetails:/技术详情/.test(t)};

const vis=(e)=>{const r=e.getBoundingClientRect(); const s=getComputedStyle(e); return r.width>1&&r.height>1&&s.visibility!=='hidden'&&s.display!=='none'&&r.top<innerHeight&&r.bottom>0;}; const els=[...document.querySelectorAll('button,a[href],[role=button],summary,[role=tab],label')].filter(vis); const small=[]; for(const e of els){ const r=e.getBoundingClientRect(); const b=getComputedStyle(e,'::before'); let w=r.width,h=r.height; if(b.content!=='none'&&b.position==='absolute'){ const ins=['top','right','bottom','left'].map(k=>parseFloat(b[k])||0); w=Math.max(w,r.width-ins[1]-ins[3]); h=Math.max(h,r.height-ins[0]-ins[2]); } if(Math.min(w,h)<24) small.push((e.innerText||e.title||e.className).toString().replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,16)+' '+Math.round(w)+'x'+Math.round(h)); } return {n:els.length, under24:small.length, sample:small.slice(0,6)};
